Steps:
1. go to {container} (moving to the container location)
2. open {container} (opening the container to access its contents)

Workflow: search_and_open_multiple_containers
When to use: when an object is expected to be inside one of several closed containers and must be systematically searched
Steps:
1. go to {container} (moving to the container location)
2. open {container} (opening the container to access its contents)
3. go to {next_container} (moving to the next container location)
4. open {next_container} (opening the next container to access its contents)
5. repeat steps 3 and 4 for all remaining containers until {object} is found

Workflow: search_and_open_container
When to use: when an object is expected to be inside a closed container and the container must be opened to access it
Steps:
1. go to {container} (moving to the container location)
2. open {container} (opening the container to access its contents)

Workflow: open_receptacle_and_place_object
When to use: when an object is in hand and needs to be placed into a receptacle that is initially closed
Steps:
1. go to {receptacle_location} (moving to the receptacle location)
2. open {receptacle} (opening the receptacle to prepare for placement)
3. move {object} to {receptacle} (placing the object in the receptacle)

Workflow: search_and_open_receptacle_for_placement
When to use: when an object is found and needs to be placed into a receptacle that is initially closed
Steps:
1. go to {receptacle_location} (moving to the receptacle location)
2. open {receptacle} (opening the receptacle to prepare for placement)
3. move {object} to {receptacle} (placing the object in the receptacle)

Workflow: find_and_place_in_openable_receptacle
When to use: when an object is found and needs to be placed into a receptacle that is initially closed and must be opened
Steps:
1. go to {object_location} (searching for {object})
2. examine {object_location} (checking if {object} is present)
3. take {object} from {object_location} (picking up the object)
4. go to {receptacle_location} (moving to the receptacle location)
5. open {receptacle} (opening the receptacle to prepare for placement)
6. move {object} to {receptacle} (placing the object in the receptacle)

Workflow: find_and_discard_in_receptacle
When to use: when an object is found and needs to be discarded into a receptacle (e.g., a garbage can)
Steps:
1. go to {object_location} (searching for {object})
2. examine {object_location} (checking if {object} is present)
3. take {object} from {object_location} (picking up the object)
4. go to {receptacle_location} (moving to the receptacle location)
5. move {object} to {receptacle} (discarding the object in the receptacle)
